items.text: We drawmagneticfieldslike thatinFigure 20.5using magneticfield lines. Magneticfield lines don'treallyexistbut theyhelpus tovisualise themain features ofamagneticfield.

items.label: text
items.text: The magneticfield lines:

items.label: list_item
items.text: show the shape of themagneticfield

items.label: list_item
items.text: show the direction of the magneticforce-the field linestravelfrom north to south

items.label: list_item
items.text: show the strengthof themagneticfield-thefield lines areclosest together where themagneticfield is strongest.

items.label: text
items.text: Avoid skin contactwith iron filings since they iritate the skin.Do not blow them off the paper,because they may get into the eyes,which is very painful.
